title: Cost and Environmental Impact Comparison Between Rigid and Flexible Pavement
degree: Master of Engineering in Civil Engineering (Construction Technology and Management)
institution: Bahir Dar University Institute of Technology
topicSummary: The thesis compares two families of road pavement on two criteria: what they cost and what they do to the environment. Rigid pavement carries traffic on a Portland cement concrete slab; flexible pavement spreads the load through layers of asphalt and granular material. The choice between them is one of the basic decisions in road design, and it shapes construction cost, maintenance needs and environmental footprint over a road's life.
